notes.title: A.I. Space Corps goes Final Release
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that A.I. Space Corps completed its Early Access phase and is now available as full version! Many new features, missions and locations made it into the game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/423180

A.I. Space Corps is a top-down space shooter taking place in the far future universe of A.I. Invasion. As the captain of a space ship it is your duty to defend bases, transmit intelligence through enemy sectors and reclaim occupied stations. Can you survive the dangers of outer space and fight back the merciless A.I.?

Full list of features

    3 different ships with distinct attributes
    flexible weapon upgrades throughout missions
    strategic gameplay through various board systems like secondary weapon or temporary shields
    different merciless enemy robots that have to be approached strategically
    various challenge missions and Steam leaderboards to compete on


The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: Hotfix July 14
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We just shipped a minor hotfix to solve a problem about the level end.

There was a problem where Fermi would skip the level end sequence to keep running into the subatomic space indefinitely. This problem should be solved and all your particle experiments should lead to success from now on! :)

Best Regards

notes.title: A new update for Fermi's Path is live!
notes.notes:
Fermi's Path keeps improving for free!

We finalized the level editor. You can now add Tokens, Explosives, Gates and a secret path to your custom levels. With these features added, the level editor is complete and it is possible to design fully fleshed out levels which can compete with levels designed by our team! Some more new features made it into the editor as well. We updated the comprehensive level editor guide and recommend you to have a look before getting your hands dirty:

 http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/FP_Workshop_Guide.pdf 

Additionally, along with various bug fixes, we improved the GUI and unlocked the Steam cloud feature to allow save files to stay synchronized with all your devices.

Most important changes/additions
added Steam cloud save feature
 added animations to Fermi on level start & level end
 added a level end music
 added loaded profile hint to main menu
 added Gamepad button hints to level selection
 added Tokens, Explosives and Gates to the level editor
 unlocked copy/paste functionality in the level editor
 improved achievement detection especially for save files created with the demo version


So jump onto the path and work on those highscores, touch up the custom level you have in mind and stay tuned for the features we have planned for you next :)

The Fermi's Path Team

notes.title: Try Fermi's path for free - demo version now available!
notes.notes:
Fermi's Path, the action-packed and music-driven arcade game published recently by GameArt Studio is now available as a free demo version.

In Fermi's Path players jump into the role of a particle called Fermi and embark on a voyage along a subatomic path. Driven by the rhythm of the electronic soundtrack Fermi hunts down the highscore as he avoids obstacles and defeats enemy particles. 

Every player who wants to test the high-speed game and its catchy sounds can download the free demo from the Fermi's Path Steam page:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/342650.

The demo version contains the complete first 3 Levels of the game – so each player can test the game easily before they decide to get the full version. The full version offers many additional features such as an Infinity-mode, a level editor and popular Steam Community features. 

The Fermi's Path team wishes all the players lots of fun on their voyage through the subatomic world of Fermi! 

P.S.: The Steam Workshop contains the first Level, which was created by a Player. Can you defeat all bosons?

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=433055792

notes.title: Fermi's Path update released!
notes.notes:
Hello,

we just shipped a minor path that should solve some issues with the game. Mostly stuff you may not have noticed at all, but important fixes to make your journey across the subatomic path go smooth at all times! :)

Relevant changes/fixes

gamepad users can now create new save files without using mouse/keyboard
the functionality of some achievements was adjusted
in infinite mode, the music now keeps playing after reaching the paths end / restarting


The Fermi's Path Team
